verdict.rationale: Lever's developer API documents list endpoints such as 'List all applications', 'List deleted applications' and 'List all audit events', so data can likely be pulled out programmatically. Nothing in the evidence describes a bulk export, the output formats, or offboarding. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open/standard export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), coverage of all data types (candidates, feedback, files), migration/offboarding guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
